title: Yummy Moroccan Chestnut Stew
description: A sweet and savory Moroccan chestnut stew brimming with lamb, chestnuts, apricots, and aromatic spices.
instructions: Heat oil in a heavy pot over medium heat.
Add diced onion and cook until translucent.
Stir in minced garlic and cook for 30 seconds.
Add lamb cubes and brown on all sides.
Sprinkle cumin, paprika, and cinnamon over the lamb and stir to coat.
Pour in chicken stock and tomato paste, bring to a gentle simmer.
Add chestnuts, apricots, and toasted almonds, stir well.
Cover and let the stew simmer for 45 minutes, until lamb is tender.
Stir in honey and lemon juice, adjust seasoning with salt and pepper.
Serve hot over couscous or rice, garnished with fresh parsley.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
